review_candidates.title: Senior Platform Engineer (Cloud)
review_candidates.description: About TD SYNNEX We're TD SYNNEX, a leading IT distributor and solutions aggregator for the IT ecosystem. We're 23,000 of the IT industry's best and brightest, who share an unwavering passion for bringing compelling technology products, services, and solutions to the world. We're an innovative partner that helps our customers maximize the value of IT investments, demonstrate business outcomes, and unlock growth opportunities. Role Overview As a Senior Platform Engineer, you will build, operate, and continuously improve the multi-cloud infrastructure platform that our development teams rely on every day. This is a hands-on engineering role - you will spend most of your time writing Terraform, Ansible, and Python, Automation and more... not just producing architecture diagrams or reference designs. You will work within an established platform direction set by our Architecture and Engineering Leadership, and your focus will be on implementing, automating, and operating the platform components that bring that direction to life. We are looking for a builder and innovator mindset who enjoys turning patterns and standards into production-ready, well-automated infrastructure that our developers and customers love to consume. Key Responsibilities Build and maintain: Implement multi-cloud infrastructure (primarily Azure, with AWS where applicable) following established platform patterns and standards. Infrastructure as Code: Write, maintain, and refactor Terraform modules. Apply DRY principles across landscapes and contribute to our shared module library. Configuration automation: Develop Ansible playbooks, roles, and collections for OS-level configuration and zero-downtime deployments. Operate AI-ready services: Provision and operate the cognitive service environments (Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock) that our application teams consume. CI/CD delivery: Build and maintain Azure DevOps pipelines for infrastructure platform provisioning and configuration management. Day-2 operations: Troubleshoot, patch, harden, and monitor platform components. You own the health of what you build. Collaboration: Work closely with Architects, Developers, and Operations to turn requirements and patterns into working code. What This Role Is Not To set clear expectations and avoid mismatched applications: This is not a Cloud Architect, Solution Architect, or Enterprise Architect role. You will not set the overall cloud strategy or produce high-level reference architectures. You will not lead multi-team design forums or own architectural governance. If you are looking for an architecture role, this position will not be the right fit. If you are looking forward to spending your day building and automating, please read on. Technical Requirements Technology Platform. Azure: strong hands-on experience (required). AWS: working hands-on experience (good to have). GCP: working hands-on experience ( is a plus). Linux administration: solid experience with RHEL, Debian, and Ubuntu (a plus) Windows hosts: comfortable managing them through automation. AI services (consumer side): comfortable provisioning, scaling, and supporting consumption of cognitive services such as Azure AI Foundry or AWS Bedrock. You operate these services for application teams - you are not expected to design AI/ML systems. Infrastructure as Code & Automation Terraform: strong working knowledge of data structures, functions, workspaces, and module design. You write modules, not just consume them. Ansible: confident with playbooks, roles, and dynamic inventories. Exposure to Ansible Automation Platform (AWX / Tower) or RedHat Satellite is a plus. Scripting: fluency in Python, Bash, or PowerShell for day-to-day automation tasks. Work Delivery Azure DevOps: Pipelines, Boards, and Repos. GitOps: solid branching strategies, code reviews, and lifecycle management. Agile: comfortable working in sprints and breaking platform work into small, deliverable units. Soft Skills & Ways Of Working Pragmatic problem-solver: you favour shipping a working iteration over a perfect design document. Clear communicator: you can explain what you built - and the trade-offs - to both engineers and non-engineers. Reliable executor: you take ownership of tickets through production and follow up on operational issues you uncover. Collaborative: you work well alongside Architects and Product Owners, and you ask questions before assuming. Why Join Us? You will join a platform team that is actively professionalizing how the wider organization consumes cloud and AI services. You will spend your time writing high-quality code, automating real problems, and seeing your work used by developers or other customers across the business - not sitting just in design meetings. If you enjoy the craft of platform engineering and want to deepen your hands-on multi-cloud and automation skills, this is the role for you. What We Offer We value continuous learning and provide a clear progression plan. Remote or Hybrid work We provide comprehensive benefits including, Health insurance, paid leave, retirement plans, and more. Certified Workplace Excellence: Work in a certified Great Place to Work. At TD SYNNEX, our values guide everything we do: Together, We Own It, We Dare to Go, We Grow and Win, and above all, We Do the Right Thing. These principles shape how we work with each other, our partners, and our communities as we drive innovation and create lasting impact. What's In It For You? Elective Benefits: Our programs are tailored to your country to best accommodate your lifestyle. Grow Your Career: Accelerate your path to success (and keep up with the future) with formal programs on leadership and professional development, and many more on-demand courses. Elevate Your Personal Well-Being: Boost your financial, physical, and mental well-being through seminars, events, and our global Life Empowerment Assistance Program. Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: It's not just a phrase to us; valuing every voice is how we succeed. Join us in celebrating our global diversity through inclusive education, meaningful peer-to-peer conversations, and equitable growth and development opportunities. Make the Most of our Global Organization: Network with other new co-workers within your first 30 days through our onboarding program. Connect with Your Community: Participate in internal, peer-led inclusive communities and activities, including business resource groups, local volunteering events, and more environmental and social initiatives. Don't meet every single requirement? Apply anyway. At TD SYNNEX, we're proud to be recognized as a great place to work and a leader in the promotion and practice of diversity, equity and inclusion. If you're excited about working for our company and believe you're a good fit for this role, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly the person we're looking for!
